name: Summer Institute
city: New York City (all five boroughs) and Newark, NJ
what_you_do: A 6-week summer leadership program. You take classes on identity, social justice and leadership. You meet women and gender-expansive leaders. You go on field trips and college visits.
who_can_apply: Young women and gender-expansive youth enrolled in high school who live in New York City or Newark and have not done Summer Institute before. No grade or skill rules.
pay_detail: Eligible for a $450 stipend at the end of the summer, based on participation.
duration: 6 weeks. In 2026: July 6 to Aug 13, Monday to Thursday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., at sites in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Newark.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed. Its deadline was March 13, 2026, with group interviews April 7 to 11 in NYC. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Apply Now page when the cycle opens, then join a group interview. Sign up for the opportunities email list to hear when it opens. Questions: nashers@sadienash.org.
notes: For young women and gender-expansive youth. The Brooklyn, Queens and other borough sites are part of the same program.
